headline: SLB (SLB) Stock Looks Reasonable Despite Its 93% Five Year Run
summary: SLB has almost doubled investors' money over the past five years, yet its latest intrinsic value work using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach still points to a sizeable gap between the current share price and what the cash flows imply. SLB has returned 93.0% over the last five years, which puts recent valuation questions in the context of a stock that has already rewarded patient holders.
